boards.title: Team Challenges
boards.description: Five bomb modules, from beginner to expert. Combine your private clues and cut every wire in order.

clues.prompt: Beginner: cut all 3 wires in the correct order.

puzzle.message: Beginner: cut all 3 wires in the correct order.
hints: Cut the circle first.
Cut the star second.
Cut the triangle last.

clues.prompt: Easy: cut all 4 wires in the correct order.

puzzle.message: Easy: cut all 4 wires in the correct order.
hints: The square is first.
The triangle comes immediately after the square.
The circle comes immediately before the star.
The star is last.

clues.prompt: Intermediate: cut all 5 wires in the correct order.

puzzle.message: Intermediate: cut all 5 wires in the correct order.
hints: The triangle is first and the circle is last.
The diamond comes before the star.
The star comes before the square.
The square comes before the circle.

clues.prompt: Hard: cut all 6 wires in the correct order.

puzzle.message: Hard: cut all 6 wires in the correct order.
hints: The diamond is first. The square is last.
The circle is immediately before the sun.
Exactly one wire is cut between the sun and the star.
The triangle is immediately before the star.

clues.prompt: Expert: cut all 7 wires in the correct order.

puzzle.message: Expert: cut all 7 wires in the correct order.
hints: The cross is fourth. The triangle is last.
The sun is before the square, and both are before the diamond.
The diamond is before the cross. The circle is after the cross.
The star is immediately after the circle.
